name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション 頭領ドロロロボ
name.en: Keroro Sergeant Plastic Model Collection Chief Dorororobo

description.ja: 武者ケロロロボシリーズ最後の１体“頭領ドロロロボ”参上。
description.en: The last member of the Musha Keroro Robo series, “Chief Dororo Robo,” has arrived.

description.ja: ペガサス形態に組み換え可能。
description.en: Can be recombined into Pegasus form.

description.ja: 同シリーズアイテムとの組み換え遊びが可能！ 武者ケロロロボ（別売）、足軽タママロボ（別売）、藪医クルルロボ（別売）、浪人ギロロロボ（別売）と組み合わせれば、遂に五体合体完成！
description.en: You can play with the same series items! When combined with Musha Keroro Robo (sold separately), Ashigaru Tamama Robo (sold separately), Bush Doctor Kururu Robo (sold separately), and Ronin Giroro Robo (sold separately), the five-body combination is finally completed!
